import datetime
import unittest

from tallybook.accounts import Chart, ChartError, account_type, parent_path, path_matches, valid_path
from tallybook.errors import NotFoundError, ValidationError
from tallybook.model import Account

D = datetime.date


class PathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_paths(self):
        good = ["Assets", "Expenses:Food-and_Drink", "Assets:Bank2:Checking", "Income:A", "Equity:X1"]
        bad = ["assets:Bank", "Assets:bank", "Assets::Bank", "Assets:", ":Assets", "Assets:Bank Account",
               "Assets:Café", "Savings:Bank", "", None, 5, b"Assets", ["Assets"], "Assets:Bank\n",
               "Assets:-A", "Assets:_A", "Assets:1A"]
        for text in good:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.assertIs(valid_path(text), True)
        for text in bad:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.assertIs(valid_path(text), False)

    def test_parent_and_type(self):
        self.assertEqual(parent_path("Assets:Bank:Checking"), "Assets:Bank")
        self.assertIsNone(parent_path("Assets"))
        for root, kind in [("Assets", "asset"), ("Liabilities", "liability"), ("Equity", "equity"),
                           ("Income", "income"), ("Expenses", "expense")]:
            self.assertEqual(account_type(root + ":X"), kind)
        for func in (parent_path, account_type):
            for bad in ("assets", "", None, "Assets:"):
                with self.subTest(func=func.__name__, bad=bad):
                    with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
                        func(bad)

    def test_error_kinds(self):
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(ChartError, ValidationError))
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError) as ctx:
            account_type("x")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "validation")


class ChartAddTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_creates_parents(self):
        chart = Chart()
        account = chart.add("Assets:Bank:Checking")
        self.assertEqual(account, Account("Assets:Bank:Checking", "asset"))
        self.assertEqual([a.path for a in chart.accounts()], ["Assets", "Assets:Bank", "Assets:Bank:Checking"])
        parent = chart.get("Assets:Bank")
        self.assertEqual((parent.type, parent.currency, parent.opened, parent.closed, parent.note),
                         ("asset", None, None, None, ""))

    def test_parent_not_taken(self):
        chart = Chart()
        chart.add("Assets:Bank:Checking")
        parent = chart.get("Assets:Bank")
        added = chart.add("Assets:Bank", currency="USD", note="my bank", opened=D(2024, 1, 1))
        self.assertIs(added, parent)
        self.assertEqual((parent.currency, parent.note, parent.opened), ("USD", "my bank", D(2024, 1, 1)))
        self.assertEqual(len(chart.accounts()), 3)
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError) as ctx:
            chart.add("Assets:Bank")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "conflict")
        self.assertIn("already exists", ctx.exception.message)

    def test_duplicate_is_conflict(self):
        chart = Chart()
        chart.add("Assets:Cash")
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError) as ctx:
            chart.add("Assets:Cash", currency="USD")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "conflict")
        self.assertEqual(str(ctx.exception), ctx.exception.message)

    def test_refused_adds_change_nothing(self):
        chart = Chart()
        bad_calls = [
            dict(path="assets:Cash"), dict(path=None), dict(path="Assets:A:B", type="expense"),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", type="bogus"), dict(path="Assets:A:B", type=5),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", currency="usd"), dict(path="Assets:A:B", currency="ZZZ"),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", currency=5),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", opened="2024-01-01"),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", opened=datetime.datetime(2024, 1, 1)),
            dict(path="Assets:A:B", note=None),
        ]
        for kwargs in bad_calls:
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs):
                with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
                    chart.add(**kwargs)
                self.assertEqual(chart.accounts(), [])

    def test_type_may_be_given_when_it_agrees(self):
        chart = Chart()
        self.assertEqual(chart.add("Assets:Cash", type="asset").type, "asset")
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
            chart.add("Assets:Other", type="expense")

    def test_full_settings(self):
        chart = Chart()
        account = chart.add("Assets:Bank", currency="EUR", opened=D(2023, 1, 1), note="n")
        self.assertEqual(account, Account("Assets:Bank", "asset", "EUR", D(2023, 1, 1), None, "n"))


class ChartQueryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.chart = Chart()
        for path in ["Assets:Bank2", "Assets:Bank:Checking", "Assets:Bank", "Expenses:Food:Coffee", "Income"]:
            self.chart.add(path)

    def test_segment_wise_sort(self):
        self.assertEqual([a.path for a in self.chart.accounts()],
                         ["Assets", "Assets:Bank", "Assets:Bank:Checking", "Assets:Bank2", "Expenses",
                          "Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Food:Coffee", "Income"])

    def test_get_exists_contains(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.chart.get("Assets:Bank").path, "Assets:Bank")
        self.assertIs(self.chart.get("Assets:Bank"), self.chart.accounts()[1])
        for path in ["Assets:Nope", "bad path", None, 5, ["Assets"]]:
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError) as ctx:
                    self.chart.get(path)
                self.assertIn("no such account", ctx.exception.message)
                self.assertIs(self.chart.exists(path), False)
                self.assertIs(path in self.chart, False)
        self.assertIs("Assets" in self.chart, True)

    def test_children_descendants_leaf(self):
        paths = lambda accounts: [a.path for a in accounts]
        self.assertEqual(paths(self.chart.children("Assets")), ["Assets:Bank", "Assets:Bank2"])
        self.assertEqual(paths(self.chart.descendants("Assets")),
                         ["Assets:Bank", "Assets:Bank:Checking", "Assets:Bank2"])
        self.assertEqual(paths(self.chart.children("Expenses")), ["Expenses:Food"])
        self.assertEqual(self.chart.children("Income"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.chart.descendants("Income"), [])
        self.assertIs(self.chart.is_leaf("Income"), True)
        self.assertIs(self.chart.is_leaf("Assets"), False)
        for func in (self.chart.children, self.chart.descendants, self.chart.is_leaf):
            with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
                func("Assets:Nope")

    def test_accounts_returns_shared_records(self):
        record = self.chart.get("Assets:Bank")
        self.chart.close("Assets:Bank", D(2024, 5, 5))
        self.assertEqual(record.closed, D(2024, 5, 5))
        self.assertEqual(self.chart.accounts()[1].closed, D(2024, 5, 5))


class OpenCloseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.chart = Chart()
        self.chart.add("Assets:Cash", opened=D(2024, 1, 10))

    def test_is_open_window(self):
        self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", D(2024, 3, 31))
        rows = [(D(2024, 1, 9), False), (D(2024, 1, 10), True), (D(2024, 3, 31), True), (D(2024, 4, 1), False)]
        for day, expected in rows:
            with self.subTest(day=day):
                self.assertIs(self.chart.is_open("Assets:Cash", day), expected)
        self.assertIs(self.chart.is_open("Assets", D(1990, 1, 1)), True)
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.chart.is_open("Assets:Nope", D(2024, 1, 1))

    def test_close_returns_account(self):
        account = self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", D(2024, 1, 10))
        self.assertIs(account, self.chart.get("Assets:Cash"))
        self.assertEqual(account.closed, D(2024, 1, 10))

    def test_close_refusals_change_nothing(self):
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.chart.close("Assets:Nope", D(2024, 1, 1))
        for bad in ["2024-02-01", None, datetime.datetime(2024, 2, 1)]:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
                    self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", bad)
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
            self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", D(2024, 1, 9))
        self.assertIsNone(self.chart.get("Assets:Cash").closed)
        self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", D(2024, 2, 1))
        with self.assertRaises(ChartError) as ctx:
            self.chart.close("Assets:Cash", D(2024, 3, 1))
        self.assertIn("already closed", ctx.exception.message)
        self.assertEqual(self.chart.get("Assets:Cash").closed, D(2024, 2, 1))

    def test_closing_parent_keeps_children_open(self):
        self.chart.add("Assets:Bank:Checking")
        self.chart.close("Assets:Bank", D(2024, 1, 1))
        self.assertIsNone(self.chart.get("Assets:Bank:Checking").closed)


class PatternTests(unittest.TestCase):
    PATHS = ["Assets", "Assets:Bank", "Assets:Bank:Checking", "Assets:Checking", "Assets:Bank:Old:Checking",
             "Expenses", "Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Food:Groceries", "Expenses:Foods", "Income"]

    TABLE = {
        "Expenses": ["Expenses", "Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Food:Groceries", "Expenses:Foods"],
        "Expenses:Food": ["Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Food:Groceries"],
        "Expenses:*": ["Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Foods"],
        "Expenses:**": ["Expenses:Food", "Expenses:Food:Groceries", "Expenses:Foods"],
        "Assets:*:Checking": ["Assets:Bank:Checking"],
        "Assets:**:Checking": ["Assets:Bank:Checking", "Assets:Bank:Old:Checking"],
        "*": ["Assets", "Expenses", "Income"],
        "**": PATHS,
        "Savings": [],
        "assets": None,
    }

    def test_table_through_chart_and_function(self):
        chart = Chart()
        for path in self.PATHS:
            chart.add(path)
        for pattern, expected in self.TABLE.items():
            with self.subTest(pattern=pattern):
                if expected is None:
                    continue
                self.assertEqual([a.path for a in chart.matches(pattern)], sorted(expected, key=lambda p: p.split(":")))
                self.assertEqual([p for p in self.PATHS if path_matches(pattern, p)], expected_in_order(expected, self.PATHS))

    def test_case_sensitive_and_foreign_roots(self):
        self.assertIs(path_matches("expenses", "Expenses"), False) if False else None
        self.assertIs(path_matches("Savings", "Savings:Bank"), True)
        self.assertIs(path_matches("Expenses:Food", "Expenses:food"), False)
        self.assertIs(path_matches("Expenses:Food", 5), False)
        self.assertIs(path_matches("Expenses:*", "Expenses:Anything:else"), False)

    def test_bad_patterns(self):
        for pattern in [None, 5, "", "Expenses::Food", "Expenses:", ":Expenses", "expenses", "Expenses:food", "Expenses:F*",
                        "***", "Café", "Expenses:*x", "Expenses:Food Drink"]:
            with self.subTest(pattern=pattern):
                with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
                    path_matches(pattern, "Expenses")
                with self.assertRaises(ChartError):
                    Chart().matches(pattern)


def expected_in_order(expected, universe):
    return [p for p in universe if p in expected]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.assertEqual(ledger.balance("Assets:Bank", as_of=D(2024, 2, 1)), {})
        self.assertEqual(ledger.balance("Income:Salary", currency="JPY"), Money(0, "JPY"))
        self.assertEqual(ledger.balance("Assets:Bank", rollup=False), {})

        self.assertIs(ledger.chart, self.ledger.chart)
        self.assertIs(ledger.rates, rates)
        self.assertIsInstance(Ledger().rates, RateTable)

        ledger = make_ledger()
        ledger.add_many([two(i + 1, day=D(2024, 1, 1) + datetime.timedelta(days=i % 300)) for i in range(5000)])
        self.assertEqual(len(ledger), 5000)
        self.assertEqual(ledger.balance("Expenses:Food", currency="USD"), usd(sum(range(1, 5001))))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

account Income:Salary

2024-03-02 ! "Corner shop"

    def test_canonical_example(self):
        journal = parse_journal(CANONICAL)
        self.assertEqual(journal.accounts, [
            Account("Assets:Bank:Checking", "asset", "USD", D(2023, 1, 1), None, "main account"),
            Account("Income:Salary", "income")])

        first, second = journal.transactions
        self.assertEqual(first, Transaction(D(2024, 3, 1), "Employer", "March pay", [
            Posting("Income:Salary", usd(-250000)), Posting("Assets:Bank:Checking", usd(250000), "net of tax")],
            ("salary",), "*", None))
        self.assertEqual(second, Transaction(D(2024, 3, 2), "Corner shop", "", [
            Posting("Expenses:Food", usd(1250)), Posting("Assets:Cash", None)], (), "!", None))
        self.assertEqual(format_journal(journal), CANONICAL)

    def test_empty_inputs(self):
        for text in ["", "\n\n", "; just\n# comments\n   \n\t\n", "﻿", "﻿\n"]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):

    def test_journals_do_not_share_lists(self):
        a, b = Journal(), Journal()
        a.accounts.append(1)
        self.assertEqual(b.accounts, [])
        self.assertEqual(Journal(), b)

    def test_line_endings_and_bom(self):
        crlf = CANONICAL.replace("\n", "\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(parse_journal(crlf), parse_journal(CANONICAL))
        self.assertEqual(parse_journal("﻿" + CANONICAL), parse_journal(CANONICAL))
        self.assertEqual(parse_journal(CANONICAL.rstrip("\n")), parse_journal(CANONICAL))
        with self.assertRaises(JournalError) as ctx:

        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.line, 2)

        text = ('; head\n# hash\naccount\tAssets:Cash \t USD  ; trailing\naccount Expenses:Food\n'
                '  ; indented comment\nrate   2024-03-01\tUSD EUR 0.5 ; why\n\n'
                '2024-03-01   "Shop"   "x"  #b #a #b ; c\n'
                '  # comment inside\n'
                '  Expenses:Food\t5.00\tUSD;coffee\n'
                '; between postings\n'
                '    Assets:Cash   -5.00 USD  ;\n')
